Priyanka (New Hire): Hey all, first week q — I'm prepping a partner demo and hit 429s when I ramped to ~30 concurrent streams. Which key should I be using for demos and is there a fast path for a temporary burst?

DevEx Bot: Welcome! For demos use the SANDBOX key when possible. Hosted keys are for production traffic. If you need a short hosted burst, file a support request in Console -> Help -> Support -> Request quota increase and tag @infra.

Priyanka (New Hire): Sandbox supports streaming and embeddings, right? My sandbox run also returned 429s a few times.

Owen (Infra): It does, but sandbox has much smaller buckets. Also check whether your CI shares an egress IP — many 429s are proxy-level IP throttles. Quick test: run a curl from your laptop (off VPN) and compare to CI.

Priyanka (New Hire): Nice. What's a simple curl I can run?

Owen (Infra): Example:
```
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $SANDBOX_KEY" \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"model":"rwd-small","input":"ping"}'
```
If laptop works and CI returns 429, it's egress/IP.

Priyanka (New Hire): If it's an egress/IP issue, can infra give a temporary dedicated IP for a ~2 hour demo?

Owen (Infra): We can sometimes allocate a short-lived egress IP. Include that request in the support ticket along with project id, start/end times, peak QPS, and whether you're streaming. Tag @infra in the ticket.

Priyanka (New Hire): Any quick retry/backoff guidance? My initial retry loop retried aggressively and made things worse.

Owen (Infra): Use exponential backoff with jitter and cap concurrency. Our SDKs implement sensible defaults. If you implement manually: initial 250ms, max backoff ~4s, random jitter, and abort after N attempts. Avoid immediate tight loops on 429.

DevEx Bot: If you paste the new ticket link here, @DevEx will prod infra during business hours for faster turnaround. Short bursts are often fulfilled in 1-2 hours if capacity exists.

Priyanka (New Hire): Filed ticket #6210 with demo window and peak QPS. Switching to laptop-run + smaller concurrency for now. Thanks! :pray:
